sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Bacterial culture testing (CPT code 87081, CPT code 87070, CPT code 87071) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE in cases of viral pharyngitis. • Amplification testing (CPT code 87651) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE in cases of viral pharyngitis. • Rapid antigen diagnostic testing (RADT) (CPT code 87880) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE for any of the following: – As a follow-up test to bacterial culture test (CPT code 87081, CPT code 87070, CPT code 87071) for a Streptococcal infection within the prior 14 days – In cases of viral pharyngitis • Serological titer testing (CPT code 86060, CPT code 86215) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE in patients with Streptococcus . • Direct probe testing (CPT code 87650) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE if amplification testing (CPT code 87651) for Streptococcus has been performed on the same date of service. • The following tests ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE in patients with Streptococcus or Enterococcus : – Anti-streptolysin O immunoassay (CPT code 86060, CPT code 86063) – Tests that screen and identify multiple Streptococcal strains, using either immunoassay or nucleic acid-based assays, such as the Solana Strep Complete Assay and the Lyra Direct Strep Assay (CPT code 83789, CPT code 87430) • The quantification of any strain of Streptococcus using nucleic acid amplification, including polymerase chain reaction (PCR), (CPT code 87652) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.
